_comment: Android SPEC — what a player buys. traits DERIVE the mechanics (neediness -> longing fill/call, intimacy -> intimate-clip gate). Eva is a companion-tier model: more emotions, more warmth, full intimacy. Use `tuning` to override any derived value (e.g. fast timings for testing the call/search chain).

capabilities._chroma_note: Key color for her clips. Assuming GREEN like Ada; change if she holes/fringes. Options: white | green | magenta.
capabilities._audio_note: Muted for now — her clips have baked-in voice lines that replayed and read as 'repeating herself'. Conversation stays text-only via comm.
capabilities._emotions_note: Conversational emotions only (neutral implicit). Intimate/gated clips live in _gated_clips and are NOT free emotion picks.

_tuning_note: Uncomment to override trait-derived values. Handy for testing the call->search chain fast.
